description: Fictional online store used to demonstrate an FAQ chatbot.

questions: How do I place an order?
What are the steps to order a product?
How do I purchase an item?
faqs.answer: Browse the catalog, add items to your cart, click Checkout, enter your delivery address and choose a payment method. You will receive a confirmation email as soon as the order is placed.

questions: How can I track my order?
How do I check the status of my delivery?
faqs.answer: Open My Orders in your account and click Track next to your order, or use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email. Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after dispatch.

questions: How do I change my order?
I made a mistake in my order, can I modify it?
faqs.answer: You can cancel or edit an order within 1 hour of placing it, from the My Orders page. After that, the order goes into preparation and can no longer be changed, but you can return it once it is delivered.

questions: Can I order without creating an account?
Do I need an account to buy?
faqs.answer: Yes, guest checkout is available. Creating an account is free and lets you track orders, save addresses and return items more easily.
Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days and express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days. The estimated date is shown at checkout.
Standard shipping costs $4.99 and express shipping costs $9.99. Shipping is free for standard delivery on orders over $50.

questions: Can you deliver to other countries?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to more than 40 countries. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days, and customs fees may apply depending on your country.

questions: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
I entered the wrong address, what can I do?
faqs.answer: You can change the delivery address within 1 hour of placing the order from My Orders. If the order has already shipped, contact our support team as soon as possible.

questions: What happens if I am not home for the delivery?
The courier could not deliver my package
faqs.answer: The carrier will try to deliver two more times. If delivery still fails, your parcel is sent to a pickup point and held for 7 days before being returned to us.

questions: The product I received is damaged
faqs.answer: We are sorry about that. Please contact support within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo of the damage, and we will send a replacement or a full refund.

questions: My package has not arrived yet
My delivery is taking too long
faqs.answer: If your order has not arrived 2 business days after the estimated delivery date, contact support with your order number and we will investigate with the carrier.

questions: What payment methods do you accept?
Can I pay by credit card or mobile money?
faqs.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, mobile money and Nova gift cards.

questions: Is it safe to pay on your website?
Do you store my card details?
faqs.answer: Yes. All payments are encrypted and processed by certified payment providers. We never store your full card number.

questions: The payment did not go through
faqs.answer: A payment can be declined because of insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or a security block from your bank. Check your details, contact your bank, or try another payment method.
Yes. For orders over $100 you can pay in 3 monthly installments with no extra fees. Select Pay in 3 at checkout.

questions: How do I use a promo code?
Where do I enter my discount code?
My coupon code does not work
faqs.answer: Enter your code in the Promo code field at checkout and click Apply. Only one code can be used per order, and some codes are not valid on sale items.

questions: Why do I see two charges on my card?
faqs.answer: A second charge is often a temporary authorization hold that disappears within 3 to 5 business days. If both payments remain after that, contact support with your order number.

questions: How many days do I have to return an item?
faqs.answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery, as long as they are unused and in their original packaging.

questions: How do I return an item?
What are the steps to send back a product?
faqs.answer: Go to My Orders, select the item and click Return. Print the prepaid return label and drop the parcel at any carrier pickup point.

questions: When will I get my refund?
How long does a refund take?
faqs.answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive your return.

questions: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
How do I swap a product?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose Exchange instead of Return when you start the return, and we will send the new item as soon as your parcel is scanned by the carrier, subject to stock.

questions: Are there products that are not refundable?
faqs.answer: For hygiene reasons, underwear, opened cosmetics, personalized items and digital gift cards cannot be returned.

questions: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Click Sign up at the top of the page, enter your email and choose a password. You will receive a verification email to confirm your account.

questions: How do I reset my password?
I cannot log in to my account
faqs.answer: Click Forgot password on the login page and enter your email. We will send you a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

questions: How do I update my personal information?
How can I change my address or phone number?
faqs.answer: Go to Account Settings, then Profile or Addresses, edit your information and click Save.

questions: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings, then Privacy, and click Delete account. Your personal data is permanently removed within 30 days.
Yes. All products come directly from the brands or from authorized distributors, and every item is quality checked before shipping.

questions: The product I want is out of stock
Will this item be available again?
How do I get notified when an item is back in stock?
faqs.answer: Click Notify me on the product page and enter your email. We will let you know as soon as the item is back in stock.

questions: Do your products come with a warranty?
What if my device stops working?
faqs.answer: Electronics come with a 2-year warranty and other products with a 1-year warranty. Contact support with your order number to start a warranty claim.

questions: How can I contact customer support?
How do I talk to someone?
faqs.answer: You can reach us by email at support@novamarket.example or through live chat, Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 GMT. We reply to emails within 24 hours.

questions: Do you have a physical store?
faqs.answer: Nova Market is an online-only store. You can collect your orders for free at one of our pickup points.

questions: Do you have a mobile app?
Can I shop from my phone?
Is there an Android or iPhone app?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Nova Market app is available for iOS and Android. Search for Nova Market in your app store.
